input.quote: 14.2.6 Termination for Change of Control of PB. PB will notify SFJ in writing promptly (and in any event within [***]) following the entering into of a definitive agreement with respect to a Change of Control of PB. SFJ may, in its sole discretion, terminate this Agreement in its entirety at any time following a Change of Control of PB that occurs prior to the date of payment by PB of the final Approval Payment.
input.rationale: Section 15.6 itself is at or above the preferred position: it is mutual, lets PB assign without consent to an Affiliate or to a successor by merger, stock sale or asset sale (including reverse triangular mergers), and additionally bars SFJ from assigning to a pharma/biotech competitor without PB's sole-discretion consent. The Affiliate/successor guarantee requirements in p0816 and the encumbrance covenants in 7.5.3 are ordinary financing protections, not an assignment gate, and Section 6.7.2's Change of Control Buy-Out is PB's option (benefits us). The failure is Section 14.2.6: it gives SFJ a sole-discretion right to terminate the entire Agreement following a Change of Control of PB, plus a 150% of Development Costs payment — squarely the playbook's walk-away (a Vendor right to terminate or re-price on Customer's change of control), and it undercuts the M&A carve-out granted in 15.6. Redline deletes SFJ's termination right and the associated payment while keeping PB's notice obligation.

proposal.summary: Delete SFJ's right to terminate on a PB Change of Control (and the related 150% payment), retaining PB's notice obligation.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have removed SFJ's discretionary right to terminate (and the associated 150% of Development Costs payment) upon a Change of Control of PB, since our playbook does not permit a counterparty termination or re-pricing right triggered by our change of control. PB's prompt notice obligation is retained, and Section 15.6 continues to govern assignment to a successor; we can also discuss SFJ protection via the existing Change of Control Buy-Out mechanics in Section 6.7.2.

ops.oldText: 14.2.6 Termination for Change of Control of PB.

SFJ may, in its sole discretion, terminate this Agreement in its entirety at any time following a Change of Control of PB that occurs prior to the date of payment by PB of the final Approval Payment. In the event that SFJ terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 14.2.6, then, in exchange for purchasing the Trial Data Package including the Research Results included therein as set forth in Section 11.1.1.4, PB will pay to SFJ within [***] of the date of termination an amount equal to one hundred fifty percent (150%) of Development Costs which were paid or incurred by SFJ.
ops.newText: A Change of Control of PB shall not give SFJ any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement or any payment hereunder, and this Agreement shall continue in full force and effect following such Change of Control in accordance with Section 15.6.
